title: Projection painting and texturing heads in Blender

queue.claim: bpy.ops.paint.project_image ('Apply Camera Image') projects an image from the active scene camera when the image has no stored view_data, uses render resolution and pixel aspect for framing (so it honours lens shift and sensor fit), and applies Texture Paint's Occlude, Backface Culling and Normal settings; it still exists in Blender 5.2 LTS and 5.3.
queue.query: Blender paint.project_image "Apply Camera Image" active camera texture paint

queue.claim: Blender ignores JPEG EXIF orientation when loading images, so portrait phone photos load rotated.
queue.query: Blender image EXIF orientation ignored JPEG rotated

queue.claim: The UV Project modifier with a camera projector uses the camera's lens, sensor fit and lens shift (plus the user's Aspect X/Y); with several projectors, each face takes the projector it faces most directly; the limit is 10 projectors.
queue.query: Blender UV Project modifier camera projector aspect lens shift sensor fit

queue.claim: Blender defaults: Texture Paint seam Bleed 2 px, Normal fade angle about 80 degrees, Screen Grab Size 512; Cycles bake margin 16 px with margin type Adjacent Faces/Extend (about 3.1+); Unwrap margin 0.001; Smart UV Project angle limit 66 degrees.
queue.query: Blender manual texture paint options bleed normal angle occlude backface
